# Site, settings and domains

## integrations.set

Set the site's consent categories, the outside scripts each holds and the banner that asks visitors for them, whole; null clears them. A script loads from an https address only, configured by `data-*` attributes; a script of an asked category runs only once the visitor grants it, one of a `required` category always. A site that asks for any category holds the banner. Refused with `invalid_input` when the record breaks its own rules (a category or a script listed twice, a script in a category the site lacks, no banner for an asked category).

- **op**; class `integrations` (Administrator); dry_run_ops judges it; one undo in History takes it back.
- Found by the plain words: "analytics", "cookie".

| Input | Type | Required | Says |
|---|---|---|---|
| `integrations` | { policyVersion: integer ≥1, categories: { key: string, label: string (min 1, max 80), description?: string (min 1, max 400), required?: true }[] (≤8), scripts: ({ id: string, category: string, src: string, placement: "head" \| "body", async?: true, defer?: true, attrs?: Record<string, string (max 500)> })[] (≤32), bann… (the whole schema: discover_operations with names) | yes | Whole: `policyVersion` (raise it to ask every visitor again), `categories` (key, label, description, `required: true` for always on), `scripts` (id, category, https `src`, placement head or body, async, defer, `data-*` attrs) and `banner` (its texts, their translations by language, the look variant). Null clears them. |

Example input:

```json
{"integrations":{"policyVersion":1,"categories":[{"key":"necessary","label":"Necessari","required":true},{"key":"analytics","label":"Statistiche","description":"Ci dicono quali pagine vengono lette, in forma anonima."}],"scripts":[{"id":"plausible","category":"analytics","src":"https://plausible.io/js/script.js","placement":"head","defer":true,"attrs":{"data-domain":"archiplan.it"}}],"banner":{"texts":{"title":"Cookie","body":"Usiamo cookie tecnici e, con il tuo consenso, statistiche anonime.","accept":"Accetta","reject":"Rifiuta","manage":"Scegli","save":"Salva","policyLabel":"Cookie policy","policyHref":"/cookie"}}}}
```

## site.setLocales

Set the site's languages and, per language, the languages it reads before the main one when a text is missing. The main language is the one the texts are stored in and does not change here: send it as it is (site.setMainLocale makes another language the main one, its texts with it). A language dropped while pages hold its translations keeps them and reports `l10n.orphan`. Refused with `site.locales` (a changed main language, the main language missing from the list, a language twice, a fallback that is no site language, the main language or itself).

- **op**; class `settings` (Designer, Administrator); dry_run_ops judges it; one undo in History takes it back.
- Found by the plain words: "translate", "language".

| Input | Type | Required | Says |
|---|---|---|---|
| `defaultLocale` | string \| null | yes | The site's main language, as it is now (site.setMainLocale changes it); null only in an undo. |
| `locales` | string[] (≤32) \| null | yes | Every language of the site, the main one among them: BCP 47 tags (`it`, `en`, `en-US`); null only in an undo. |
| `fallbacks` | Record<string, string[] (≤8)> \| null |  | Per language, the languages it reads in order before the main one when a text is missing there (`{ "en-US": ["en"] }`); absent or null: none. |

Example inputs:

```json
{"defaultLocale":"it","locales":["it","en"]}
```
```json
{"defaultLocale":"it","locales":["it","en","en-US"],"fallbacks":{"en-US":["en"]}}
```

## site.setMainLocale

Make another of the site's languages its main one, in one step everywhere a text lives. Its translations become the site's own texts and the old main language becomes a translation, its words kept; a text it had no translation of keeps the old main language's words. Its addresses lose their language prefix and the old main language's take one; old addresses answer with a redirect. Dry-run it first and tell the person what it answers: output { was: the old main language, missing: how many texts kept the old words, places: where (kind, id, name, count) }. Refused: `site.mainLocale` (already the main language, or not one of the site's languages: add it with site.setLocales first).

- **op**; class `settings` (Designer, Administrator); dry_run_ops judges it; one undo in History takes it back.
- Found by the plain words: "translate", "language".

| Input | Type | Required | Says |
|---|---|---|---|
| `locale` | string | yes | The language that becomes the main one: one of the site's languages (site_context locales) other than its main one. |

Example input:

```json
{"locale":"en"}
```

## site.restoreMainLocale

Put back every text, address and language setting a change of the site's main language wrote, as it was. Libretto writes it as the undo of site.setMainLocale; a batch that sends it is refused (only Libretto makes it). To change the main language again, send site.setMainLocale.

- **op**; class `reserved` (no one sends it: Libretto writes it); dry_run_ops judges it; one undo in History takes it back.

| Input | Type | Required | Says |
|---|---|---|---|
| `values` | Record<string, string \| number \| boolean \| null \| (string \| number \| boolean \| null \| (… \| … \| … \| … \| … \| …)[] \| Record<string, … \| … \| … \| … \| … \| …>)[] \| Record<string, string \| number \| boolean \| null \| (… \| … \| … \| … \| … \| …)[] \| Record<string, … \| … \| … \| … \| … \| …>>> | yes | Each leaf the step wrote as it was, by document path (site, pages/<id>, content/<id>, navigation/<key>, collections/<id>/items/<id>, forms/<id>, media/<id>, settings/general); null: it was absent. |

Example input:

```json
{"values":{"site":{"locales":["it","en"],"defaultLocale":"it","fallbacks":null},"navigation/main":null}}
```

## site.setSeo

Set the site's search defaults whole: the title template every page title goes in, and the description, social image and noindex of the pages that set none. Pages never copy them, so a change reaches every page at once. The object replaces the stored one (send every field you keep); null clears them all. Refused with `head.image` when the social image is no raster image of the media library.

- **op**; class `settings` (Designer, Administrator); dry_run_ops judges it; one undo in History takes it back.
- Found by the plain words: "seo", "share", "sharing".

| Input | Type | Required | Says |
|---|---|---|---|
| `seo` | { titleTemplate?: string (min 2, max 200), description?: string (min 1, max 1000), ogImage?: uuid, noIndex?: true } \| null | yes | The defaults, whole; null clears them. |

Example input:

```json
{"seo":{"titleTemplate":"%s — {site}","description":"Archiplan, studio di architettura e interior design a Roma.","ogImage":"86ec6080-05c6-423e-a6b3-d921c8449495"}}
```

## settings.setNotFound

Name the page a visitor sees, with status 404, at an address no page answers: one page, and optionally another per language. Null goes back to the built-in page. Refused with `notFound.page` (no such page, a page with no tree, or the home page) and `notFound.locale` (a language the site does not have).

- **op**; class `settings` (Designer, Administrator); dry_run_ops judges it; one undo in History takes it back.

| Input | Type | Required | Says |
|---|---|---|---|
| `notFound` | { pageId: string (min 1, max 36), locales?: Record<string, string (min 1, max 36)> } \| null | yes | `pageId`, a page of the site (site_context lists them), and `locales`, language → another page for that language; null: the built-in page. |

Example inputs:

```json
{"notFound":{"pageId":"c41d7e2a-9b3f-4a58-8e16-2f0b7d9a3c54"}}
```
```json
{"notFound":null}
```

## settings.setGeneral

Set or clear the site values pages show (its name, tagline, company name, support e-mail and legal line) and its pictures (its icon and the logo search engines show). A field given is set, null clears it, a field left out is kept. Refused with `settings.picture` when a picture's media id is not in the media library or is no image or SVG.

- **op**; class `settings` (Designer, Administrator); dry_run_ops judges it; one undo in History takes it back.
- Found by the plain words: "brand", "logo", "favicon", "site".

| Input | Type | Required | Says |
|---|---|---|---|
| `general` | object | yes |  |
| `general` › `siteName` | string (min 1, max 120) \| null |  | The site's name: what headers, footers and page titles show; null clears it. |
| `general` › `siteDescription` | string (min 1, max 300) \| null |  | The site's tagline; null clears it. |
| `general` › `companyName` | string (min 1, max 200) \| null |  | The company behind the site, as footers and legal lines show it; null clears it. |
| `general` › `supportEmail` | string \| null |  | The e-mail address pages show for contact; null clears it. |
| `general` › `legalLine` | string (min 1, max 500) \| null |  | The legal line a footer shows (company number, VAT); null clears it. |
| `general` › `favicon` | uuid \| string (max 2048) \| null |  | The site's icon (browser tab, phone home screen): a media id of an image or an SVG, or a file URL; null clears it. |
| `general` › `organizationLogo` | uuid \| string (max 2048) \| null |  | The logo search engines show for the site (absent: the icon): a media id of an image or an SVG, or a file URL; null clears it. |

Example inputs:

```json
{"general":{"siteName":"Archiplan","companyName":"Archiplan S.r.l.","supportEmail":"studio@archiplan.it","favicon":"56e5f9e5-0d24-4b78-a01b-ec706bfd93b7"}}
```
```json
{"general":{"legalLine":null}}
```

## domain.add

Connect a hostname to the site; it waits for its DNS record (read it with domain.list) and its certificate, checked with domain.verify. It cannot be dry-run. Alone in a batch; base revisions are read by the door.

- **door**, alone in its batch; class `platform` (Administrator); no confirmation; **cannot be dry-run**; not undoable.
- Found by the plain words: "domain".

| `pair` | boolean |  |

Example input:

```json
{"hostname":"www.example.com","pair":true}
```

## site.create

Create a new site in the workspace of this token's site, as New site in the admin does: a core site started from a blueprint (`blueprintId`, default `blank`), in the blueprint's languages with `defaultLocale` as its main language when the blueprint's core form is written in it. `slug` names its address (lowercase letters, digits and single hyphens). Run it alone in a batch; it cannot be dry-run and is not undoable (a person deletes a site in the admin). Answers `{ created: { id, slug, name, blueprintId, programId, engine, locales, defaultLocale }, next }`. A workspace token reaches the new site on its next request: call site_context, then name its siteId; a token of other sites does not reach it.

- **door**, alone in its batch; class `platform` (Administrator); no confirmation; **cannot be dry-run**; not undoable; limit: 10 sites an hour per token, created and copied together.
- Found by the plain words: "site".

| Input | Type | Required |
|---|---|---|
| `name` | string (min 1, max 255) | yes |
| `slug` | string (min 1, max 100) | yes |
| `blueprintId` | string (min 1, max 100) |  |
| `defaultLocale` | string |  |

Example input:

```json
{"name":"Studio Rossi","slug":"studio-rossi","blueprintId":"blank","defaultLocale":"it"}
```

## site.duplicate

Copy this site into a new site of its workspace, as Duplicate on the websites list does: the draft as it is now, with its media and font files, under a new `name` and address (`slug`: lowercase letters, digits and single hyphens). Its members, domains, form messages, versions and history are not copied; the copy is published once, as made. Run it alone in a batch; it cannot be dry-run and is not undoable (a person deletes a site in the admin). Answers `{ created: { id, slug, name, … }, next }`; a workspace token reaches the copy on its next request.

- **door**, alone in its batch; class `platform` (Administrator); no confirmation; **cannot be dry-run**; not undoable; limit: 10 sites an hour per token, created and copied together.
- Found by the plain words: "site".

| Input | Type | Required |
|---|---|---|
| `name` | string (min 1, max 255) | yes |
| `slug` | string (min 1, max 100) | yes |

Example input:

```json
{"name":"Studio Rossi (copy)","slug":"studio-rossi-copy"}
```
